C1.worst_defect: Home never says who it is for or not for, and never places itself against Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed. 'Quick start' and 'Try with your store' sit side by side as near-duplicate CTAs with no hint which to pick.

C2.worst_defect: Home says 'MIT licensed' and 'open-source till' but never mentions that building the till yourself 'needs your own RxDB Premium licence token in RXDB_PREMIUM'. That appears only on Limitations and Connect a till. Refunds and Customer note wait on 'a plugin release after 0.3.0, which is not out yet', with no date, and the last release was 2026-10-06 (three releases in five days, then six weeks of silence). No maintainer or organisation is named on home.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 footer / home.txt vs limitations.txt, connect-a-till.txt, at-the-till.txt, changelog.txt

C3.worst_defect: Step 8 has you type the Vendure admin email and password into the hosted app.vendurepos.com. The reassurance about where that data goes is only on Connect a till, and there is no sign-in screenshot. On a real store, refunds at the till are 'Not yet', so the path stops short of a full till.

C4.worst_defect: The changelog is written for insiders: '(ADR 0005)', 'order.create v5', 'TALLY-CUSTOM-ITEM', '(#116)', 'TallyPosV51790900000000'. A buyer cannot tell what changed for them. The 'after 0.3.0' caveats are scattered over home, At the till and Limitations instead of being stated once.

C5.worst_defect: The docs sidebar's grey panel stops at about y=900 and leaves bare white below it in the desktop slices. Home's lower half is a long run of ten near-identical grey feature cards with no visual hierarchy.

C6.worst_defect: The phone header's menu toggle is a bare chevron with no 'Menu' label or hamburger. The hero product screenshot at phone width shows a truncated 'Q...' column header.

C7.worst_defect: og-image.png is cropped mid-UI at the 'Add charge' row. Sitemap lastmod values are all build times (2026-11-17/18), not content dates. quick-start LCP is 2.6 s, and the 404 page logs a console error for its own 404.
C7.where: og-image.png; tech.json sitemap, lighthouse quick-start, not-found console

overall_worst.defect: Home sells an 'MIT licensed', 'open-source till' but hides that self-building the till needs a paid RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM). That is stated only on Limitations and Connect a till. Refunds on a real store wait on an undated 'plugin release after 0.3.0, which is not out yet', six weeks after the last release (2026-10-06). A client cannot tell what is free or when the gaps close.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 footer / home.txt vs limitations.txt, connect-a-till.txt, changelog.txt
overall_worst.fix: Add one line on home under 'Before you start', e.g. 'Self-building the till needs an RxDB Premium licence; the hosted app.vendurepos.com does not.' Give the next plugin release a target date or link its milestone wherever 'after 0.3.0' appears.
